title: FeatureStore
description: The declarative manifest of a feature store: entities (join keys) and feature views (groups of features sourced from a certified derivation, keyed by entity and an event timestamp). Implementations load this schema as data and validate against it rather than mirroring it in code.

specVersion.description: The version of the Feature Store Spec this manifest conforms to.

kind.description: The manifest kind. Always 'FeatureStore' for this schema.

entities.description: The objects features describe, each identified by a join key.

featureViews.description: Named groups of features, each sourced from a certified derivation.

joinKey.description: The column that identifies this entity in feature and entity data.

entities.description: Names of the entities this view is keyed by.

source.description: The certified derivation whose rows supply this view's feature values.

timestampField.description: The event-time column in the source rows, enabling point-in-time joins. When absent, the view holds a single current value per entity.

ttlSeconds.description: How far back a point-in-time join may look from each entity timestamp. Absent means unbounded.

features.description: The feature columns exposed. When absent, every source column that is not a join key or the timestamp is exposed.
